episodes.title: The First Day
episodes.summary: A silver-haired girl warns Shirou Emiya of the Holy Grail War. Rin Tohsaka summons her Servant Archer and goes to look for other Masters to fight.

episodes.title: Night of Fate
episodes.summary: Shirou gets killed by Lancer, but Rin brings him back to life. When Lancer tries to kill Shirou again, Shirou summons Saber.

episodes.title: Raising the Curtain
episodes.summary: Saber and Lancer do battle briefly. Shirou meets Rin and learns about the Holy Grail War.

episodes.title: The Strongest Enemy
episodes.summary: The silver-haired girl, Illyasviel von Einzbern, summons her Servant, the Berserker hero Heracles, to attack Shirou and Saber.

episodes.title: The Two Magi (Part 1)
episodes.summary: Shirou introduces Saber to his close friends. Later on, he is attacked by Rin, but a female Servant appears.

episodes.title: The Two Magi (Part 2)
episodes.summary: Shirou and Rin form an alliance to track down the female Servant, Rider.

episodes.title: Writhing
episodes.summary: Saber is furious that Shirou did not get her involved to track down Rider. Later on, Shirou encounters Rider and her master, Shinji Mato.

episodes.title: Dissonant Melody
episodes.summary: Shinji directs Shirou to Ryudo Temple, citing there is a powerful Servant there. Shirou and Saber continue to clash. Rin moves in with Shirou.

episodes.title: Elegance Under the Moon
episodes.summary: Saber battles the Servant, Assassin, but is confronted by another Servant who can cast magic.

episodes.title: The Calm Interlude
episodes.summary: Shirou has a quiet day with Saber, Illya and Rin.

episodes.title: Blood Fort Andromeda
episodes.summary: Shirou is caught in a trap by Rider.

episodes.title: Splitting the Sky
episodes.summary: Saber and Rider do battle.

episodes.title: Winter Castle
episodes.summary: As Saber rests from her battle, she recalls her time as King of Britain. Shirou is kidnapped by Illya.

episodes.title: The Ideal Conclusion
episodes.summary: Rin, Archer and Saber look for Shirou, and Illya sets Berserker on them.

episodes.title: The Twelve Trials
episodes.summary: Illya and Berserker come back for another fight.

episodes.title: The Sword That Brings the Promised Victory
episodes.summary: Shirou is able to use his magic to aid Saber and defeat Berserker. He later takes home Illya with him.

episodes.title: Mark of the Witch
episodes.summary: With mass comas now occurring within the city, Shirou and the others decide to go after the Master and Servants at the Ryudo shrine. Sakura is taken captive by Caster to serve as a sacrifice to summon the Holy Grail.

episodes.title: Decisive Battle
episodes.summary: Shirou, Rin and Saber attempt to rescue Sakura and to stop the Holy Grail from being summoned.

episodes.title: The Golden King
episodes.summary: With victory all but won for Caster, an unknown Servant appears and kills her and her Master. Saber tells the story of this new Servant.

episodes.title: Distant Trace of a Dream
episodes.summary: Shirou takes Saber out on a date around town.

episodes.title: Separation of Heaven and Earth and the Creation of a Star
episodes.summary: Coming back from their date, Shirou and Saber are attacked by the new servant, Gilgamesh.

episodes.title: Result of a Wish
episodes.summary: Shirou is captured and nearly killed by Rin's guardian Kirei Kotomine, but Saber comes in time and saves him. Kirei makes a grand revelation about the Holy Grail.

episodes.title: Holy Grail
episodes.summary: Illya is abducted by Kirei.

episodes.title: The All Distant Utopia
episodes.summary: Shirou and Saber defeat Kirei and Gilgamesh, but what will they do with the Holy Grail?
